newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia govt to coordinate Eurobond issues-agency.
newsitem.headline: Russia govt to coordinate Eurobond issues-agency.

text.p: The Russian government is considering coordinating Eurobond issues by Russian regions and companies, Interfax news agency quoted a senior minister as saying on Friday.

"There are lots of questions linked to the order of Eurobond issuing by regions and companies. I think that in the nearest future we will clarify this order," the agency quoted First Deputy Prime Minister Vladimir Potanin as saying.
He said there was a threat that massive issues of Eurobonds could oversupply the international market, making it harder to place them.
Russia issued a highly successful debut Eurobond last November, and Potanin said Russia would make a second issue later this year.
Several Russian cities, regions, companies and even ministries have announced plans to issue Eurobonds.
